purpose: Prove the canonical Work Item execution shell locally: each Work Item carries stable Council-level identity, type, summary, state group, owner candidate, approved owner where known, source references to existing sibling-slice CSR ids, rationale, approval requirement, semantic contract version, and a creation receipt; no Microsoft platform identifier is used as primary product identity (platform ids appear only inside source references); and the Council Queue queueView exposes all seven state groups. Receipts here are local contract evidence only, and every live mutation stays receipt-gated to Epic 2 Story 2.3.

workItems.com_title: Decide whether the manual summary source produces executable Council work
workItems.com_summary: Review the summary-allowed manual source and decide whether it should become approved Council work, be held, or be ignored after extraction review.
workItems.com_confidence_summary: Owner candidate confidence 0.82. Source is local sample evidence, not tenant verified; approved owner reflects the known single human operator only.
workItems.com_rationale: The manual summary source explicitly says it can be reviewed later for zero, one, or many proposed Work Items. A decision Work Item is proposed because human judgment is required before any execution, and the Work Item identity is Council-level (CWI-LOCAL-*) independent of the source system.
workItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the source rationale and either approves, holds, ignores, or asks for a more specific extraction.

workItems.com_title: Delegate follow-up on the mock Outlook message reference once live reads are approved
workItems.com_summary: Determine whether the mock Outlook message reference represents a real follow-up that can be delegated once live Microsoft Graph reads are authorized; no external action until then.
workItems.com_confidence_summary: Owner candidate confidence 0.70. The source is explicitly mock/manual evidence; approved owner is unknown until a verified Outlook message and a delegate are confirmed.
workItems.com_rationale: The Outlook Source Record proves message/conversation reference shape, but live Graph reads are not authorized. A delegation Work Item is proposed and cannot trigger external action; its primary identity is Council-level (CWI-LOCAL-*) and the Graph-style source object ref stays inside the source reference, never as the Work Item identity.
workItems.com_recommended_next_action: After live-read approval, compare against a verified Outlook message, confirm a delegate, and decide whether to keep, replace, or ignore the proposed delegation.

workItems.com_title: Track risk that publisher prefix approval may slip past the Epic 5 readiness gate
workItems.com_summary: The 2026-07-13 platform sync raised the risk that Dataverse publisher prefix approval could slip past the Epic 5 tenant readiness gate; this Work Item tracks that risk as proposed Council work.
workItems.com_confidence_summary: Owner candidate confidence 0.75. Source is a local sample meeting summary, not tenant verified; approved owner is unknown until risk ownership is confirmed by a human.
workItems.com_rationale: The meeting summary explicitly flags a schedule risk against a readiness gate; risk items always require human approval before any mitigation work is created. The Work Item identity is Council-level (CWI-LOCAL-*) and independent of the manual meeting source system.
workItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the risk, confirms the Epic 5 gate dependency, and decides whether to track mitigation as separate work.

workItems.com_title: Request richer capture policy for the hash-only manual source before extraction
workItems.com_summary: The hash-only manual source is held because its source body policy is unknown or sensitive; this Work Item requests a richer capture decision before extraction can proceed.
workItems.com_confidence_summary: Owner candidate confidence 0.68. The source is hash-only with unknown sensitivity; approved owner is unknown until the capture-policy decision is made by a human.
workItems.com_rationale: The hash-only manual source retains only a content hash until Doug approves richer capture, so extraction cannot be decided. A request Work Item is proposed to drive the capture-policy decision; its identity is Council-level (CWI-LOCAL-*) and the source content hash stays inside the source reference.
workItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the sensitivity label and retention flags, then approves a richer data boundary policy or keeps the source held.

workItems.com_title: Follow up on the superseding mock Outlook thread snapshot once live reads are approved
workItems.com_summary: The superseding mock Outlook thread snapshot (CSR-OUTLOOK-THREAD-MOCK-002) supersedes the held hash-only thread; this Work Item proposes a follow-up once live Outlook reads and source body policy are approved.
workItems.com_confidence_summary: Owner candidate confidence 0.66. The source is mock/manual evidence from the Story 1.5 supersession; approved owner is unknown until a verified thread and a follow-up owner are confirmed.
workItems.com_rationale: The superseding mock thread snapshot was captured because the prior held hash-only record no longer represented the thread as observed. A follow-up Work Item is proposed and stays Council-level (CWI-LOCAL-*); the Outlook conversation and version refs stay inside the source reference, never as the Work Item identity.
workItems.com_recommended_next_action: After live-read approval, compare against a verified Outlook thread and decide whether to keep, replace, or ignore the proposed follow-up.
